command: Review root and app package scripts against the frontend command registry and latest execution logs
reviewer: Codex self-review; no independent peer review

environment.name: Windows / Node 24.19.0 / npm 11.17.0
environment.details: Current frontend workspace, exact package scripts and registered command states; domain/schema are synthetic frontend checks.

expected: Root/app scripts match package manifests; commands are registered only after actual successful logs, while unrun or baseline-failed commands remain distinct.
observed: 17 root scripts and 5 app scripts reviewed against 20 registry rows. E2E is now VERIFIED_AVAILABLE after the full Chromium Playwright suite passed 9/9; build-demo and the deprecated contracts npm script remain DECLARED_NOT_RUN. The E2E log SHA is recorded in the review log.
